entities.name: Samiks
entities.description: A Balduvian warrior and one of the Marked Ones who died of plague after delivering a message and the Nova Pentacle.

entities.name: Kailo
entities.description: A person Samiks waited to give a message about Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Zaraya
entities.description: Recipient of the Nova Pentacle from Samiks.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Said to have poisoned the waters of Samiks's homeland.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: An item Samiks gave to Zaraya.

entities.name: Marked Ones
entities.description: A group in the Ice Age of Dominaria that Samiks belonged to.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Ice Age.

events.summary: Dying of plague, Samiks waits in armor on a tree to deliver a message about Lim-Dûl poisoning the waters.
events.quote: he still went to deliver a message to Kailo and Zaraya about Lim-Dûl poisoning the waters of his homeland

events.summary: Samiks gives Zaraya the Nova Pentacle and dies.
events.quote: It was Samiks who gave Zaraya the Nova Pentacle and died afterwards.

relations.quote: Samiks was one of the Marked Ones in the Ice Age of Dominaria

relations.note: Lim-Dûl poisoned the waters of Samiks's homeland.
